remarks: Set on nearly half an acre south of the boulevard, 4901 Palo Drive offers a refined take on California ranch living in a coveted Tarzana hillside setting. Polished and exceptionally livable, the residence combines architectural character, beautifully updated interiors and expansive private grounds. Recently renovated with a sophisticated yet comfortable aesthetic, this 3,338 square-foot residence pairs generous proportions with warm, modern finishes and an effortless connection to its surroundings.
